description: This file defines a React component 'Head' for managing <head> elements in a Next.js application, including functions for default head content, deduplication, and context integration.

methods.name: defaultHead
methods.description: Returns default head elements, including charset and viewport meta tags, depending on AMP mode.

methods.name: onlyReactElement
methods.description: Filters React children to include only valid React elements, supporting fragments.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Creates a filter function to prevent duplicate head tags based on type, key, and meta attributes.

methods.name: reduceComponents
methods.description: Aggregates head elements from multiple <Head> instances, applying deduplication and default tags.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: React component that injects elements into <head> with deduplication and context support.
